summary: iSpecimen Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the November 2, 2026 closing of its acquisition of AI software, models, source code, data rights and IP—including the Disease-Associated Protein Discovery AI Agent and Disease Trend Prediction AI Model—from Foldlab AI Ltd. of British Columbia. Aggregate purchase price is $4,500,000: $750,000 cash at closing, two $625,000 milestone payments ($1,250,000 total) payable on delivery and acceptance of each AI product, with remaining consideration in restricted stock. The stock consideration carries a five-year lock-up with no leak-out, implemented via legends, stop-transfer instructions and a Voting Rights Agreement rather than escrow. Watch milestone acceptance and the unregistered-share overhang.
